\ednentry{
  id = {EDN-05},
  title = {A make is supported from 300 listings},
  date = {2026-09-22},
  milestone = {M1: Project Inception},
  topic = {Problem Specification},
  participants = {@lukas2510},
  decision = {Only makes with at least 300 listings in the cleaned used-car data, counted after the \texttt{ES} holdout and before the split, are supported.
The pipeline computes the list and the API rejects every other make.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item Accept all 25 makes and flag rare ones as low confidence: weak predictions for makes with a few dozen listings, and the warning needs a threshold of its own anyway.
\item Accept all makes without a rule: no scope statement, and a hidden weakness for rare makes.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} The dataset is skewed toward premium brands (EDN-01).
A threshold turns that limit into an explicit, testable rule.
At 300 it keeps 11 of the 25 makes and 98.6\,\% of the split listings.},
  ai = {Information seeking, Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation},
  response = {Accepted},
  assessment = {AI counted the listings per make after scoping and deduplication, compared thresholds of 200, 300 and 500, and recommended the threshold.
Lukas accepted because it states the brand skew openly instead of hiding it behind a warning.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code session of 2026-09-22 on issue \#2; prompt: ``How do we handle the 25 makes, many of which have very few listings?''.},
  evidence = {\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/docs/docs/problem-spec.md}{Problem specification} section 2, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/docs/docs/dataset-card.md}{dataset card}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/2}{issue \#2}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/pull/17}{PR \#17}.},
